t: This is Wellington Barracks, home to the Foot Guards units on public duties in Westminster. It sits between Birdcage Walk and Petty France, about 300 yards from Buckingham Palace, so the Guards can reach the palace quickly in an emergency. Five companies are based here, along with the Foot Guards bands and regimental headquarters. Admiral Richard Stapleton-Cotton, a Royal Navy officer in the First World War, was born here in 1873. He died in 1953.
